outcome: Childbirth experience (assessed using the Childbirth Experience Questionnaire)
finding: Women rated their childbirth experience more negatively at six weeks postpartum compared to one week postpartum, and interventions such as labor induction, augmentation, emergency cesarean section, and use of pain relief were associated with lower childbirth experience scores.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean section was associated with a lower Childbirth Experience Questionnaire score.
